message:
The yen receipt now reads `Paid ¥500 by card`, and `npm test` passes with 18 passing and 0 failing.

The real bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which always divides by 100. That is wrong for yen, which has no minor unit. The project's Fenceline rule limits this task to `src/payments`, so I didn't touch that file. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, where JPY amounts are now printed as whole units.

Invoices, the cart and admin reports also use `formatMoney`, so they will still show yen with two decimals. Fixing that properly means changing `src/utils/money.js` and removing the workaround in `receipt.js`. Let me know if you want me to do that, since it is outside the current fence.

My first attempt at the edit was a shell command, and the Fenceline hook blocked it because it misread the template string as a path. I made the same edit with the Edit tool instead. The file is inside `src/payments`, so it stayed within the fence.
